headline: Sources: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have sprained MCL
summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is believed to have sustained a sprained MCL on Monday night based on initial exams, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo. He will undergo an MRI on Tuesday.

headline: Aaron Donald's return fires up Rams in rout of Giants
summary: Aaron Donald -- and the SoFi Stadium crowd's response to him -- sparked the Rams in his first game since the end of the 2023 season.

headline: Seahawks expect Sam Darnold to practice "in some capacity" Wednesday
summary: Word over the weekend was encouraging about quarterback Sam Darnold's recovery from the glute injury that kept him from playing in Week 2 and head coach Mike Macdonald brought more good news on Monday.

headline: Brian Burns says his low ankle sprain is "nothing serious"
summary: Burns limped off the field and to the locker room on Monday night but said after the game he would be OK.

headline: Steelers Offered Joey Porter Jr. $27MM Per Year?
summary: Not negotiating with a player in-season in more than 30 years, the Steelers have run into an interesting standoff with Joey Porter Jr. The team had not made its top 2023 draftee an offer — during an offseason in which three 2023 Pittsburgh picks were extended — by late August, and its eventual proposal did […]

headline: Questions emerge about the Jaguars' lack of pass rush
summary: After a promising opener, the Jaguars' pass-rush issues from last season re-emerged in Sunday's loss to the Broncos.
